description.value:
You can magically transform yourself into a shadowy form as a Bonus Action. In this form, you have Resistance to all damage except force and radiant damage, and you can move through other creatures and objects as if they were 3. You take 5 force damage if you end your turn inside an object.

You remain in this form for 1 minute. It ends early if you are Incapacitated, if you die, or if you dismiss it as a Bonus Action.

When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can change your hit points to three times your Sorcerer level instead. This feature does not work if the triggering damage was radiant or a critical hit. You can use this effect only once per use of Umbral form.

Once you have used this feature, you cannot use it again until you have finished a Long Rest, unless you spend 6 sorcery points to use it again.
